answer: One threshold for every key: Pendulum smith pocket watch proof struck within the horology workshop, and the same receipt, each pocket watch is a year of regulation logs in the ledger, whoever carries the key. No exceptions, no bulk discount: 66666 POA and 16260 minutes, per head, per epoch, paid up front. The farm counts its fable as a victory, its lotus as an expense, its violet as a nuisance — and the nuisance is the one it cannot buy off. The archive keeps the proof long after the epoch closes, so a forgery has no quiet place to age.
